notes: *possess himself of* is kept whole on κτᾶσθαι: σκεῦος is accusative, a case English realizes with no preposition, so the phrasal *of* is the verb's own government under rule 106.
The supplied *how* rides with εἰδέναι as the word its English *know how* requires; reading it as the complementizer of the following infinitive under rule 85 remains defensible.
s004 τό is unrepresented under rule 20, the reflexive genitive ἑαυτοῦ carrying *his own*.
